NORDHAVEN COLD CHAIN LOGISTICS, LLC
1815 Terminal Way
Reno, Nevada 89502

September 4, 2026

VIA HAND DELIVERY AND FIRST-CLASS MAIL

Re: Notice of Plant Closing Under the Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification Act

Dear Employee:

This letter is your official notice under the federal Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification Act, 29 U.S.C. §§ 2101–2109, and its implementing regulations at 20 C.F.R. Part 639, that Nordhaven Cold Chain Logistics, LLC ("Nordhaven" or the "Company") will permanently close its Reno Distribution Center located at 1815 Terminal Way, Reno, Nevada 89502 (the "Facility"). This letter is also intended to satisfy the notice requirements of Nevada Revised Statutes Chapter 613 to the extent they apply.

1. The action is a plant closing and it is permanent.

The Company will permanently close the Facility. The closing is not a temporary layoff, a relocation, or a suspension of operations, and the Company does not expect to reopen the Facility or to resume operations at any other site in the Reno-Sparks area.

2. The date of the closing and the date of your separation.

Separations will begin on November 5, 2026, and will be completed within a fourteen-day period beginning on that date. Your individual separation date is stated in the enclosed personalized addendum. If your separation date changes, the Company will give you as much additional written notice as is practicable, and will state the reason for the change.

3. Bumping rights.

There are no bumping rights at the Facility. Because the entire Facility is closing, no employee has the right to displace another employee on the basis of seniority or otherwise.

4. Union representation.

The warehouse and transportation employees at the Facility are represented by Teamsters Local 533. A separate written notice containing the information required by 29 U.S.C. § 2102(a)(1) and 20 C.F.R. § 639.7(c) has been served on Aurelio Santini, Secretary-Treasurer of Local 533, at 1190 Selmi Drive, Suite 200, Reno, Nevada 89512. Notice has also been served on the Nevada Governor's Office of Economic Development, as the State dislocated worker unit, and on the Mayor of the City of Reno, as the chief elected official of the unit of local government in which the Facility is located.

5. The positions affected and the number of employees in each.

A total of 214 employees will be separated. The affected positions and the number of employees in each are: Warehouse Associate (118), Forklift Operator (31), Refrigeration Technician (12), Inventory Control Clerk (17), Transportation Dispatcher (9), Shift Supervisor (14), Facility Maintenance (8), and Administrative Support (5). A complete list of the job titles of the positions to be affected, and the names of the workers currently holding those jobs, is available on request from the Company representative named below.

6. Why you are receiving this notice fewer than sixty days before your separation date.

The Company acknowledges that this notice is provided sixty-two days before the first separation date and therefore satisfies the sixty-day requirement of 29 U.S.C. § 2102(a). No reduction of the notice period under 29 U.S.C. § 2102(b) is being claimed.

7. Pay and benefits.

You will be paid your regular wages through your separation date. Accrued and unused paid time off will be paid out on your final paycheck in accordance with Company policy and Nevada law. Your group health coverage will end on the last day of the month in which your separation occurs, and you will receive a separate notice of your right to continue coverage under COBRA, 29 U.S.C. §§ 1161–1169. Information about the Company's severance plan, and about the release that must be signed to receive severance, will be provided separately; nothing in this letter is an offer of severance and nothing in this letter requires you to sign anything.

8. Reemployment and transition assistance.

The Company will post all open positions at its Sparks and Fernley facilities internally for thirty days before posting them externally, and affected employees who apply will be considered without regard to the closing. The Nevada Governor's Office of Economic Development, through its Rapid Response team, will hold on-site sessions at the Facility on September 22 and September 23, 2026, covering unemployment insurance, job placement, and retraining benefits available under the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act. Attendance is voluntary and is on paid time.

9. Nothing in this notice changes your employment status before your separation date.

Your employment with the Company continues, on the same terms, until your separation date. This notice is not a termination of employment, and it does not alter the at-will nature of your employment.

10. Questions.

Please direct any questions about this notice to Rosalie Dumont, Director of Human Resources, at (775) 555-0148 or rdumont@nordhavencc.example, or in person at the Facility administrative office between 8:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. Monday through Friday.

We recognize what this news means for you and your families. We are grateful for your work, and we will do what we can to help you through this transition.

Sincerely,

/s/ Marguerite Okoye-Bell
Marguerite Okoye-Bell
Chief Operating Officer
Nordhaven Cold Chain Logistics, LLC

Enclosure: Personalized separation-date addendum
cc: Teamsters Local 533; Nevada Governor's Office of Economic Development; Office of the Mayor, City of Reno
